in_sanskrit.name: उपेन्दर
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: उप (upa) - near, प्रे (pre) - before, इश्वर (ishvar) - lord; Upendar means the one who is present before the supreme lord.

in_hindi.name: उपेन्दर
in_hindi.long_meaning: उप (upa) - near, एक्षा (ekshaa) - desire, वाला (vaala) - possessor, देव (dev) - god; Upendar means the one who possesses the desire to be near the god.

in_tamil.name: உபேந்தர்
in_tamil.long_meaning: உத்தம (uttamam) - supreme, இஷ்வரன் (ishvaran) - lord; Upendar means the supreme lord.

in_telugu.name: ఊపేదర్
in_telugu.long_meaning: ఊప (upa) - near, ఎద్ది (eddi) - desire, జ్జోటి (jajjoti) - present, పోయింద (pooyindu) - possessing, ఇశ్వర్ (ishvaru) - lord; Upendar means the one who possesses the desire to be near the lord.

in_marathi.name: Upendar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Upendar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Upendar is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Upena' which means 'near' and 'Dharma' which means 'law'. Upendar is a name for a lord or ruler who is near to the law or dharma. This name is often used as a title for deities in Hinduism, indicating their divine status and their role in maintaining the order of the universe.
